accepted.definition: indicating exactness or preciseness
accepted.simpleMeaning: In a way that is completely right, with no difference at all.
accepted.scope: It is not a rough guess, and not a short way of saying you agree.
examples: The train left at exactly seven o'clock.
The two copies look exactly the same.
branchCoverage: indicating exactness or preciseness -> in a way that is completely right, with no difference at all

accepted.definition: disposing of property by voluntary transfer without receiving value in return
accepted.simpleMeaning: The act of handing over money or property to someone as a gift, with nothing received back.
accepted.scope: It is not a sale or exchange for payment, and not the act of handing a small object to someone.
examples: The giving of the land to the town was recorded in the will.
Their regular giving keeps the shelter open.
branchCoverage: disposing of property by voluntary transfer without receiving value in return -> the act of handing over money or property to someone as a gift, with nothing received back
